name: Restart if a reboot is pending (Windows)
description: Checks for a pending reboot and, if one is needed, schedules a restart after a delay with a visible message. Will not stack a second schedule. Dry run by default.

params.name: delay_minutes
params.label: Delay in minutes
params.description: Minutes before the restart happens (1 to 1440).

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When enabled, nothing is changed and the script only prints what it would do.

output: Reasons a reboot is pending and a [DRY-RUN]/[DONE]/[SKIP] line. Exit 0; exit 2 on a bad delay; exit 3 if scheduling failed.
